name: portal-pibic
description: Portal de Gestão de Laboratório (PIBIC): API Node/Express/Prisma + SPA React (S1 a S6)

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web && npm run db:push --prefix server && npm run db:seed --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix web && npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix web
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix server && npm run format:check --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix server && npm test --prefix web
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build --prefix web && npm run test:e2e --prefix web
